poin.isi: Google released Gemini 3.8 Flash, its newest model, at an introductory $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens.
That is half the standard rate ($1.50 / $7.50) and holds until December 31, 2026. Models keep getting better while the cost of using them falls.
Cheaper AI makes automation easier to justify. Start with the one process that eats the most time, measure the result, then expand.

headline: SMARTER MODELS,
CHEAPER TO RUN
headline_caption: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Flash at an introductory price 50% below standard rates
subjudul: What lets a business join in is not only the model, but the falling cost of using it.
